title: Dotfield delta
description: The before/after record dotfield compare writes as delta.json beside out.html: the same object as the scene-level delta block of schemas/scene.schema.json ($defs.delta), plus schema_version. Written by lib/delta.mjs diffScenes, never authored. test/compare.test.js asserts the two declarations resolve to one shape.

unpaired_ratio.description: 1 - paired nodes / nodes of the smaller scene (0 when either is empty); above 0.8 the compare is refused (DF_DELTA_NO_STABLE_IDS).

viewbox_grown_from.description: The after scene's views.2d.viewBox before it grew to cover every nodes[].from; absent when nothing grew.

ref.description: Root-relative path, the file name of an input outside the root, or room:<id>/<view>.

digest.description: sha256 of the input file (the receipt's inputs[].digest), or of the canonical projected scene for a room view.

delta_axes.description: semantic (label, sublabel, kind, tags, status, fields, record_id, room; edge label, kind, order, at), topology (group membership and the edges a node touches; edge from, to, directed), geometry (positions beyond 1 px, pos, pose_m, size_m; edge routes, via, sides), provenance (the import envelope source.ref, source.digest and captured_on excluded), presentation (color_token, shape, weight; edge variant, route, weight, label_at), evidence (evidence_ids), scope (audience, boundary; edge rule_ref).

from.description: The before position: on every removed node (its ghost) and on every node whose geometry changed (the from -> to connector).

kind.description: Removed nodes only: the before kind, so the ghost draws its glyph.

id.description: The edge id, or for an id-less edge from~to~kind~n (n: its rank among the id-less edges of that key, after scene first).

ends.description: Removed edges only: the before [from, to], so the ghost edge can be drawn.
